verdict.rationale: Decagon has a dedicated Testing & QA product plus Watchtower for flagging (natural-language criteria like frustration/policy violations) and Duet for generating tests/AOPs from real conversations, forming a scored-sample, flagged-failure, review-loop pipeline that feeds back into agent behavior. Insights/reporting and knowledge-gap suggestions further close the loop into fixes. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence of scoring methodology and quantified QA outcomes beyond vendor docs and a single customer quote.
